title: service.get
description: Retrieve services according to the given parameters.

serviceids.description: Return only services with the given IDs.

parentids.description: Return only services that are linked to the given parent services.

deep_parentids.description: Return all direct and indirect child services. Used together with parentids.

childids.description: Return only services that are linked to the given child services.

evaltype.description: Tag evaluation method. Possible values: 0 - (default) And/Or; 2 - Or.

operator.description: Possible operator values: 0 - (default) Contains; 1 - Equals; 2 - Does not contain; 3 - Does not equal; 4 - Exists; 5 - Does not exist.

tags.description: Return only services with the given tags. Format: [{"tag": "<tag>", "value": "<value>", "operator": "<operator>"}, ...]. An empty array returns all services.

operator.description: Possible operator values: 0 - (default) Contains; 1 - Equals; 2 - Does not contain; 3 - Does not equal; 4 - Exists; 5 - Does not exist.

problem_tags.description: Return only services with the given problem tags. Format: [{"tag": "<tag>", "value": "<value>", "operator": "<operator>"}, ...]. An empty array returns all services.

without_problem_tags.description: Return only services without problem tags.

slaids.description: Return only services that are linked to the specific SLA(s).

selectChildren.description: Return a children property with the child services. Supports count.

selectParents.description: Return a parents property with the parent services. Supports count.

selectTags.description: Return a tags property with service tags. Supports count.

selectProblemEvents.description: Return a problem_events property with an array of problem event objects. The problem event object has the following properties: eventid - (ID) Event ID; severity - (string) Current event severity; name - (string) Resolved event name. Supports count.

selectProblemTags.description: Return a problem_tags property with problem tags. Supports count.

selectStatusRules.description: Return a status_rules property with status rules. Supports count.

period_from.description: Starting date (inclusive; integer timestamp) for the period you're interested in.

period_to.description: Ending date (exclusive; integer timestamp) for the period you're interested in.

selectStatusTimeline.description: Return a status_timeline property containing service state changes for given periods. Format [{"period_from": "<period_from>", "period_to": "<period_to>"}, ...]. Returns an array of entries containing a start_value property and an alarms array for the state changes within specified periods.

sortfield.description: Sort the result by the given properties. Possible values: serviceid, name, status, sortorder, created_at.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

filter.description: Return only those results that exactly match the given filter. Does not support text-type properties.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Supports string and text properties.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
